title: Lanterns of Willow Marsh
premise: Find the missing lens, prepare the beacon, and choose a safe festival ending.
setting: A welcoming wetland village on the afternoon of its lantern festival.
storyPromises: Discover why the beacon cannot be lit.
Meet neighbors with different useful skills.
Remember a clue from the chosen investigation.
Repair the beacon or pause the plan safely.
Give the whole group a supportive ending.

phases.goal: Discover the missing lens and two safe leads.
phases.development: The group gathers in Festival Square.
phases.transition: The player chooses an investigation route.

phases.goal: Find the lens and understand the wind.
phases.development: A route clue leads through the boathouse and bell garden.
phases.transition: The group carries its knowledge to the wind gate.

phases.development: The group combines patience and teamwork.
phases.transition: The prepared group reaches the beacon.

phases.goal: Choose an honest and safe festival plan.
phases.development: The group reviews its trusted progress.
phases.transition: The choice determines the festival outcome.

phases.development: Success, a gentle lighting, or postponement reflects the group's choices.
phases.transition: The group shares credit and keeps a plan for tomorrow.
